purpose: Reproduce a successful published baseline before changing its method
controlled_extension_order: Retain released mechanism, weights, input and output scaling, original dt and horizon as the known-working control
Compare original decoding with current elemental projection plus common constant-pressure enthalpy closure
Extend the same frozen model's horizon only, before changing mechanism or operating envelope
For a new trained baseline, use separate output-increment or transformed-rate standardization before testing architecture changes
Change one of mechanism, data sampling, capacity, loss or horizon at a time; train/validation decisions precede a new frozen test

react_deeponet_reproduction_target.scope_note: The detailed settings below belong to the 2023 conference preprint, not a verified identical final 2024 journal implementation
react_deeponet_reproduction_target.transform: fifth root on representative data, then linear scaling to [-1,1]
react_deeponet_reproduction_target.training_samples: moving windows starting at every stored trajectory point; future time within 0-20 microseconds
react_deeponet_reproduction_target.remaining_species: separate reconstruction ANN, must be audited as part of a full-state comparison
unresolved_for_exact_reproduction: A complete matching author code/checkpoint/data release was not located in the sources inspected
Exact mechanism file/version and time sampling resolution

react_deeponet_reproduction_target.reporting_rule: A reconstruction using documented assumptions is a protocol reconstruction, not exact author-code reproduction; report both paper MAE and our per-species NRMSE
